body:
### Context
PRD §35 (stack), §36 (project structure).

### Scope
- Go module `github.com/rcpassos/mergeyard`, `cmd/mergeyard/main.go`, `internal/` packages from §36 as empty stubs.
- Subcommand dispatch for the commands in §29. Unimplemented commands print "not implemented" and exit non-zero.
- `--config <path>` global flag.
- `Makefile` or `justfile` targets: `build`, `test`, `lint`.
- GitHub Actions CI: `go vet`, `go test ./...`, build.

### Out of scope
Command behavior beyond dispatch.

### Acceptance criteria
- `go build ./...` and `go test ./...` pass locally and in CI.
- `mergeyard --help` lists every §29 command.
title: [M1] Project skeleton
